title: Butterflies
description: You catch yourself staring at your phone waiting for a reply. You replay your last conversation in your head. When did this happen?

choices.label: Tell your friends about your crush

outcomes.narration: Your friends tease you mercilessly but also help you plan. The gossip spreads faster than you expected. They find out from someone else.

choices.label: Keep it to yourself, savor the feeling privately

outcomes.narration: You guard this feeling jealously. In your room at night, you let yourself dream. It's scary how much power this person has over you without even knowing.

choices.label: Act extra casual around them to hide how you feel

outcomes.narration: You overcompensate with indifference. You laugh too loud at their jokes. You cringe at yourself constantly. They seem confused by your behavior.
